title: Assembling lanthanide–transition metal clusters on TiO2 for photocatalytic nitrogen fixation

synthesis.procedure: The article states that the cluster was obtained as described in previous work; it does not provide an explicit preparation procedure for the isolated cluster.
synthesis.temperature: reflux; subsequent crystallization at room temperature
synthesis.time: 2 hours at reflux; 1 week for crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter while hot; keep the filtrate at room temperature for 1 week to obtain block-shaped green crystals.

properties.summary: UV–visible diffuse-reflectance data for the cluster were used alongside Mott–Schottky analysis to assess its energy levels. Photoluminescence results reported for Eu52Ni56/TiO2 concern the composite, not the isolated cluster.
